_readme: The diarization scenario matrix. Each row is a claim the system should be
able to survive; a row with no wav on disk is a claim you have not tested.
wav    mono 16 kHz PCM:  ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a pcm_s16le out.wav
truth  Audacity labels (Ctrl+B at each speaker change, then Export Labels)
or RTTM. See eval_diarization.py for the format.
speaker_mode defaults to 'auto' and should STAY auto for almost every row:
the matrix is testing whether K can be discovered, and telling the engine
the answer measures nothing. 'interview_fixed' is the one row that exists
Paths are relative to this file.

scenarios.purpose: baseline — the case that already works
fixed mode still holds two identities for a whole session
multi-speaker — first row the 2-speaker default cannot pass
speaker discovery past the usual ceiling
real broadcast audio — anchor, guests, reporter
a ~3 s turn: does NEW_IDENTITY_MIN_SEC=6 erase this person?
overlap — the known weakness of VAD + embedding + clustering
two close centroids must NOT be merged into one speaker
identity drift — same speaker must not split late in a session
language robustness of the embedding model
music rejection — the pass condition is that K stays 0
